name: Performance Stretch Polo
description: Designed for active days, this performance polo incorporates stretch fabric that moves with you. Moisture-wicking technology keeps you dry, and the classic polo collar maintains a refined look.
shortDescription: Stretch polo that wicks moisture and maintains a refined look.

reviews.title: Great Fit and Stretch Comfort
reviews.comment: The Performance Stretch Polo fits like it was tailored just for me, and the fabric moves effortlessly with every swing of my arm. I love the moisture‑wicking property that keeps me dry during long days, and the subtle pattern holds up after several washes without fading.
